issue_context.title: AddOptionContract() is unable to fetch the current price of the option contract
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the behavior you expect to see for your case. -->
With OptionChainProvider, the specified option contract should be available to trade immediately after AddOptionContract(). 
#### Actual Behavior
<!--- Required. Describe the actual behavior for your case. -->
As AddOptionContract() is unable to fetch the current price of the option contract, in the option algorithms using OptionChainProvider, the filtered contract should wait until next time step to be available to trade. The algorithm returns the error message like `
Backtest Handled Error: AMZN  170616C01000000: asset price is $0. If using custom data make sure you've set the 'Value' property.` 

#### Reproducing the Problem
<!--- Required for Bugs. Describe how to reproduce the problem. This can be via a failing unit test or a simplified algorithm that reliably demonstrates this issue.  -->
https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/blob/master/Algorithm.CSharp/OptionChainProviderAlgorithm.cs

<!--- Required for Bugs. Include any system specific information, such as OS. -->
LEAN

comments: We've decided that for now you can't add contract and purchase that contract on the same time step. This is actually (somewhat) realistic as far as running in live mode is concerned. For example, if we were to add a subscription for new data and on the very next line of code query the price, there's no guarantee that we would have received a tick for that contract yet (so price would still equal zero). The alternative is to issue a history request every time we add a subscription. We actually used to do this but determined that performance cost out weighed the marginal utility. For now you'll need to add the contract on one time step and on the next time step submit the order for the contract.
